title: Quiz Show Graphics — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Challenge and countdown
scenes.purpose: Put the challenge cue on stage, then start the clock.
visuals: Indigo stage with spotlight cone, floor ellipse and fixed amber stage marks
Amber challenge card slides in from the left
Coral countdown chip 3-2-1 and a coral arc draining around the unlit bulb
Score panel shows 0/5 with empty dots

beats.development: The challenge card slides in carrying its text and settles in place.
The countdown chip appears and counts 3, 2, 1 while the coral arc around the bulb drains.

scenes.title: Accent passes to performer
scenes.purpose: Pass the challenge accent to the idea and show its reaction.
visuals: Amber spark arcs from the challenge card into the bulb
Bulb lights white with a halo and a short punch-in reaction
Spotlight and stage floor brighten, cyan ring traces the floor

beats.development: An amber spark travels on a curve from the card to the bulb.
The bulb lights and punches in; the stage lighting answers.

scenes.title: System connects and score registers
scenes.purpose: Each connection scores one point, then the 5/5 result holds.
visuals: Five cyan spokes draw out to five nodes, one after another
Each new node fills one score dot and steps the score up by one
Perimeter links join the nodes into a network
Score panel punches in; caption on a solid plate

beats.development: Five spokes and nodes connect in turn; the score steps from 1/5 up to 5/5 in sync.
Perimeter links close the network, the score panel punches in and settles, and the result holds with the caption.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM

findings: Challenge, countdown, accent pass, connection and score each take their own window. The cause always comes before its score update.
All motion has settled by 2.46 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.46–3.0 s: the result holds so the 5/5 score and the caption read clearly.

notes: SVG layers driven by one paused GSAP timeline at window.__timelines.video, with no clocks or randomness.
